provenance.notes: Visually verified partial square. The table has unrelated transposition typesetting errors; it is used here only to corroborate unfilled substitution cells.

notes: These cells are unfilled both in the historical appendix and in Lasry et al. Table 2 / Lasry dissertation Table 6.2, not merely unknown to the 1918 analysts. Baseline fills remain separate hypotheses unless an independent constraint supports them.

An illustrative square in paper Figure 2 / dissertation Figure 6.2 places VF=6 and XA=5, opposite the baseline fill. It also prints N twice (AX and XG), contradicting the final key table. Treat the two digits as unresolved, rather than elevating the inconsistent illustrative figure to an established key.

contextual_unread_records.status: Truncated odd-length source fragment; no native full-frame decryption or inserted prefix is asserted. One short four-letter group occurs in each of its first two rows. The five printed dashes remain five occupied source slots.

copy_context.status: Literal-coordinate overlap only. The p157 source-defined parts2–5 are not equated with p151 part2, which has a different 186-coordinate frame and body. Neither the missing p157 A1 prefix nor the opaque p151 STUR3FSS ending is repaired from contextual prose.

limits: No published square or numeral assignment is changed.
ZIET and BUKARST remain literal misspellings; missing display letters are bracketed separately.
The notice asks for discussion and information; it does not establish that a pacification action occurred.
RICHI and headings establish source divisions, not historical truth.
Full re-encryption proves compatibility with the stated key/frame, not uniqueness of historical plaintext.
